name: results
origin: The one-player score screen (OnePScoreUI, class UI_LEVEL_COMPLETED_ONEP) after a won and a lost level. Built from tools/reference_player/cases/results/02-zero-kill-win-next.json: seed 42, Normal, Cinema; original AI.stop and controller.addBomb fixtures make the three enemies bomb themselves (unlock-tip: the score screen with the new-outfit tip UnlockTipScreen, class UI_UNLOCK_TIP, on top; its OK at okBt's centre closes it: win-score, level 1 complete), NEXT (nextLevel's centre) plays level 2, a life pickup and a stationary self-bomb lose it (loss-score). realtime 1 lets the original timers run on wall time. Checkpoint 3.
godot_note: Godot replays the menus with the same clicks; the rounds themselves are settled by the Godot-only `settle` actions with the recorded points.

actions.godot_note: Godot cannot play the original round: it ends here with the points the original's score screen showed at win-score, and the screen opens as far into its timeline at each capture as the original's was (godot_capture.gd settle).

actions.godot_why: owner edit: the score screen moves NEXT left by 96.7, half the way from DRESS UP to MORE GAMES (tools/convert/owner_edits.json)

actions.godot_note: As above, for the lost level 2 (right after the original's own bomb, so the Space press still lands in the round).
